entries.2dba4a890ab2b4c5: In February and March 2025, the izakaya business and the karaoke business were transferred to group companies through company splits, and the reportable segment became the single segment of the Restaurant Business. In the current fiscal year, the company opened the first stores of the new formats "Grille Mia!" and "Kamakura Kabuto," converted some Steak Miya stores to "Ootoya Gohan-dokoro," and is advancing a concentration on the Restaurant Business and a reshuffling of its store lineup.
entries.3a37ae29f1802a92: A format operating cafés such as “Chiisana Mori Kōhī” and the hamburger café “Gurie Mia!”, among others.

entries.49adb47919043ebf: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥30,408 million, and the company had 247 stores (237 directly operated and 10 franchised). The reportable segment is a single segment, the Restaurant Business, under which the company operates multiple formats centered on steak, sushi and yakiniku as one company. Its parent company, Colowide Co., Ltd., holds 41.2% of voting rights (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.50bffdd09864136a: Under its corporate philosophy of "Everything for customers and employees," the company states that its basic policy is a return to the origins of the restaurant business, and that it will work to improve the quality of its restaurant business and rebuild its earnings base. It positions the Western-style, yakiniku and sushi formats as its core, and plans to develop new formats, trial composite format models, optimize its store portfolio through format conversions suited to location and customer base, and carry out planned renovations of existing stores.
entries.5fef3af71d2a9da6: A format that operates yakiniku restaurants, including 'Karubi Taisho' and 'Aji no Ganko Honoo'.

entries.b22f3100f4c18d07: The company operates restaurant chain stores, including steak, conveyor-belt sushi, yakiniku, tonkatsu, Japanese-style and Western-style, and café formats, through directly operated and franchised stores, mainly in the Tohoku to Kansai region. As of March 31, 2026, the company had 247 stores.

entries.ccef855f5d8f07c3: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company recorded a net loss of ¥1,507 million. Net income in the prior year was ¥530 million.
entries.d482bd87fbc527dc: It operates restaurant chain outlets, including steakhouses, conveyor-belt sushi, yakiniku (Japanese barbecue), tonkatsu, Japanese and Western-style dishes, and cafés, mainly in the Tohoku to Kansai regions, through company-operated and franchise outlets.

entries.dd993dc9a4d4931d: General visitors who use the stores are the customers. For franchised stores, franchisees operate the stores and provide food and beverages to visitors.
entries.e4a4c1c72932c06e: The company is a restaurant company whose parent, Colowide Co., Ltd., holds 41.2% of voting rights (as of March 31, 2026), and it belongs to the Colowide Group. It has no consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.e8a83177263781e4: The company has a store network from Tohoku to Kansai, beginning with Fukui Prefecture, where it was founded, and is positioned as a local chain that offers products and services suited to regional characteristics. It belongs to a group centered on its parent, Colowide, and its structure allows it to use group mechanisms, such as purchasing transactions for food ingredients and supplies with group subsidiaries and format conversions within the group.

entries.f1fa9ac72f8968ff: A restaurant chain of the Colowide group, operating Steak Miyas, Nigiri no Tokubei and other brands.
entries.f2b326623e34e623: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥30,408 million. In the prior fiscal year, the izakaya business and the karaoke business were transferred to group companies through a company split, so revenue decreased from ¥35,477 million in the prior year.
entries.fc252dc233be3a5e: It operates restaurant chain outlets, including steakhouses, conveyor-belt sushi, yakiniku (Japanese barbecue), tonkatsu, Japanese and Western-style dishes, and cafés, mainly in the Tohoku to Kansai regions, through company-operated and franchise outlets. From the current fiscal year, it is a single reportable segment, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥30,408 million. As of March 31, 2026, the number of outlets was 247 (237 company-operated and 10 franchise outlets).
